mapper.select: SELECT member_id FROM member WHERE email = #{email} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE email_verification SET is_verified = FALSE, verified_at = NULL, expired_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND expired_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verification ( member_id, email, code, expired_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{email}, #{code}, DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) )
mapper.update: UPDATE password_reset_token SET is_used = TRUE WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_used = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO password_reset_token ( member_id, token, expired_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{token}, DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) )
mapper.select: SELECT token_id, member_id, token, is_used AS used, expired_at, create_at FROM password_reset_token WHERE token = #{token} AND is_used = FALSE AND expired_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE password_reset_token SET is_used = TRUE WHERE token = #{token} AND is_used = FALSE AND expired_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
